_comment: Claude Desktop config for the INDstocks MCP server.
The server must run on the machine whose IP is whitelisted with
INDstocks, because order endpoints are IP-gated. If Claude Desktop runs
on your laptop, point this at the Lightsail box over ssh as below.
After adding this, set tool permissions in Claude Desktop:
place_order : Needs approval  -- NEVER Always allow
flatten     : Needs approval  -- NEVER Always allow
account, positions, scan, propose_order, check_protection : Always allow is fine
